title: ashOpenLineageSnapshot (run facet)
description: Digest-only run facet emitted by ash_open_lineage naming the AshOpenLineage.Snapshot a solve or check job consumed: its digest, purpose, input count, and distinct definition kinds. The snapshot envelope itself carries references and hashes only; this facet reduces it to the digest fingerprint. Never actor identities, tenant ids, input sources, or data values.

_producer.description: URI identifying the producer of this metadata.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the snapshot's canonical JSON encoding (RFC 8785), excluding the digest field itself. Opaque fingerprint; never a data value.

purpose.description: The snapshot's purpose as a snake_case string, e.g. "personal_week". Structural label only.

input_count.description: How many inputs the snapshot declares. Count only - never the inputs themselves.

definition_kinds.description: Distinct definition kinds the snapshot declares, e.g. ["dmn", "mzn"]. Kinds only - never keys, versions, or content.
